title: docs(adr): ADR-0146 — Studio designs, Setup administers; one editor per metadata item; paired `<base>.customize` package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHk7ekKESwMTSQFaCgEU8bn)_

Part of #27356 (rows 12, 14, 19 — the decision record behind their rulings). Fixes nothing.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 ADR-0146（Proposed）+ 重新生成 `docs/adr/README.md` 索引。只有文档，不改代码、不改 schema、不带 changeset。
- 为什么改：你在决策线程 2026-10-30 10:04–10:28Z 的裁定——Studio 管全部元数据（设计 + 目录 + 源码 / 分层 / 历史 / 诊断），Setup 只做管理；每一项只有一个编辑处；只读包上就地做覆盖；开关与克隆放在 Studio 的流上；只读包也画「在 Studio 中查看」；每个基包配一个真实的 `<base>.customize` 包，Studio 里当一个界面看。
- 风险与回滚：ADR 合并前不生效；合并后也只是声明，实施按 Rollout 四期切卡。回滚 = 改 Status 行。
- 先看：D1–D5（边界、一个编辑处、配对包、开关在项上、入口），D6（明确不做：字段表 C），D7（搬家前 Setup 要补的三张管理页），Open questions 三条等你定。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` 与 `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` 都通过（本地已跑）。
- 需要你做的：审 D1–D7 与三条 Open questions；同意则 hand-merge（Prime Directive #14）。合并后我按 Rollout 切卡。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md` — new Proposed record. D1 Studio owns all metadata, Setup owns administration; D2 one editor per item, in-place overlay editing on a read-only package; D3 a paired real `<base>.customize` package shown as one surface with its base; D4 the ADR-0126 §7 toggle and clone offered on the item in Studio, Setup keeps the overview; D5 the app → Studio bridge draws a browse entry for read-only packages (objectui#12615's verb changes, the entry stays); D6 not done (no fields table — row 14 letter C; no Setup designer; no global customization scope); D7 the Setup administration pages the move owes. Rollout in four phases; three open questions for the maintainer.
- `docs/adr/README.md` — regenerated by `scripts/adr-index.mjs` (one new row).

## Why

HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass (#27356 rows 12, 14, 19) found two designers per flow or view with two save models, no Studio entry for a code package's app, and delete / reset / toggle / clone reachable only in Setup. The maintainer ruled the boundary in the project decision thread rather than row by row; this record writes that ruling down once so the rows and every later type are executed by rule. The maintainer's words are quoted verbatim at each decision.

## Verification

- `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` → OK (index current, every record parsed).
- `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` → 942 relative link destinations resolve.
- No code, no tests, no changeset (docs-only, unpublished surface).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (n/a — docs only)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (ADR checks run; no code touched)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 速读 block is the project's maintainer-facing convention; the record itself is English with the maintainer's verbatim quotes)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
